hello.text: …There you are. I was just thinking about you… and here you are.
…Hello. I found a feather… it looks like a tiny question mark. I wonder what it wants to know.
Good morning… a dewdrop landed on my head. I think it wanted a ride.
The moon looks like it's smiling tonight… I think it saw you coming.
hello.short: The moon looks like it's smiling tonight…

hello.text: Hello, {child}… I saved you the coziest spot on my branch. I only sat on it a little.
…Hello. I saw a cloud shaped like a teacup. I think the sky was having tea.
Well… hello. The crickets said it would be nice today… crickets always know.
…Good morning. One eye is awake. The other is catching up.
I saw the first star twinkle… I think it was saying hello.
hello.short: I saw the first star twinkle…

grace_hello.text: We get an extra day together… how lovely.
…Hello. Let's look at the sky together today, the way we like.

ready_hint.text: At night I hear the tree hollow calling me. I'm not sad. Just… listening. When you're ready.

ask_ready.text: …I think I'm ready now. Will you sit with me on our branch at twilight?
…I feel ready now. We can share the rest on the branch. Sit with me?

reveal.text: Oh… hello. I'm {name}, a star listener. I think I'm your {var:family}.
reveal.caption: {name} {quirk}.

fed.text: Thank you… that was very kind of you.
…Thank you. I'll eat it slowly, to make it last.
What a {word:soft} snack… I'm nibbling it slowly, slowly.

fed_fav.text: I puffed up, round and fluffy… so many tasty treats.
So many tasty treats… now I sing two notes at once.
So many tasty treats… I did a happy little waddle.
I gave a slow, happy bow… so many tasty treats.
So many tasty treats… now I sing a soft, rolling tune.
So many tasty treats… I did a proud little hop.
I stretched up tall and proud… so many tasty treats.
So many tasty treats… now I sing a warm little trill.
So many tasty treats… I bobbed like a boat on the waves.

full.text: I'm all done, thank you… my tummy is humming a happy tune.
That was just right… thank you.

pet.text: Mm… that's nice. You're so gentle.
Right there… you found my favorite spot.
Mm… my feathers like that very much.
That's lovely… I'll hum you a thank-you.

sit.text: …we don't have to talk. We can just sit together.
There… this is a good spot.

nap.text: I'm going into my hollow… I'll dream of stars.
I'll close one eye… The other one will keep you company.
I'll take a small nap… a soft one.

not_sleepy.text: Not quite sleepy yet… my eyes are still wide.
Not quite sleepy yet… the sky still has things to show me.

game_tired.text: Enough stars for today. My eyes are full.

game_end.text: That was a {word:soft} game… thank you for playing with me.

talent_Night Vision.text: …I can see in the dark. Everything is softly glowing.
talent_Night Vision.short: I can see in the dark.

talent_Silent Flight.text: I flew across the whole room and… I didn't make a sound. Ooh.

talent_Super Radar Hearing.text: Shh… I can hear a frog three gardens away.

talent_Sweet-Dream Lullaby.caption: the stars twinkle on, one by one.

Mornings are my favorite time… to be a little bit sleepy.
…I'm saying good morning to the dew… and to the grass.
Good morning… I watch the sunrise… Hoo-hoo.
This morning, I hum softly by the moon lantern.

This is a good time for a {word:soft} perch… Want to join me?
…the clouds are slow today, just like me.

…listen, the crickets are tuning up for their song.
…there's the first star. Hello, little one.
Good evening… I watch the twilight… Hoo-hoo.
This evening, I hum softly by the moon lantern.

The moon is keeping the sky company.
…on {word:soft} nights like this, I love watching the sky with you.
A quiet night… I watch the starlight… Hoo-hoo.
Tonight, I hum softly by the moon lantern.

ambient.text: One star… two stars…
Practicing my hum… low note, high note.
The stream goes… burble, burble. Low and quick.
Morning.
A cricket… cree, cree. High and tiny.
Purple clouds… pretty.
Twigs go tick… leaves go shhh… soft.
A rustle… then quiet… then a tiny tap.
Upside-down {name}.
A hum is low… a peep is high. Listen.
…a sleepy trill.
Oh. A cozy feather.
Ruffle… fluff… better.
One slow blink… for you.
Ah… a sleepy cloud.
Fluffed up. Like a pillow.
Head tilt… hello.
Toes tucked in. Cozy.
Soft wings… mm.
A moth… dancing.
Mm… slow, slow. Just humming.
Did you know… owls can turn their heads very far?
A baby owl is called an owlet… a sweet word.
Soft feather edges… that is why owls fly so quietly.
My eyes don't roll around… so I turn my head to look.
Ah… hummingbirds can fly backwards.
Ducks have waterproof feathers… raindrops just roll off.
Ducklings walk in a line… one, two, three, four.
Some birds sleep standing on one leg… very balanced.
Penguins are birds too… they swim instead of fly.
Birds sing most in the morning… a big sunrise song.
An owl's face is shaped like a little dish… it gathers sounds.
Some owl tufts look like ears… but they're just feathers.
Some owls have one ear higher than the other… it helps them listen.
A group of owls is called a parliament… a very sleepy meeting.
Many birds have light, hollow bones… that helps them fly.

tangent.text: Oh. A rustle. …The grass, I think.
Oh. A star. Just one. Hello.
tangent.short: Oh. A star. Just one. Hello.

tangent.text: …did you hear the crickets? They started.

callback.text: …{var:starName} is out tonight. Our stars. Goodnight, {var:starName}.

carry_on.text: A {word:soft} answer. I like those too.

fallback_unsure.text: I don't know either… Let's wonder.

fallback_yes.text: {pet_phrase} Mm. Yes… I thought so too.

drift_bridge.text: Oh… now I think of something else.

lost_thought.text: …I was going to say something. It floated off.
Mm… it flew away. Bye, idea.

pairs_start.text: …The stars are sleeping face down. Shall we wake two?
Every card has a twin somewhere… I wonder which.

pairs_pair.text: A pair… they look happier side by side.

pairs_miss.text: Not that one… but now we know where it sleeps.
That card was shy. I'll remember it.

pairs_hint.text: I think I heard that one rustle.

pairs_done.text: Every card has its twin now… I like that.
All the pairs are home… we did that quietly, together.
We found every pair… I puffed up, round and fluffy.
I hopped from twig to twig… we found every pair.
We found every pair… now I sing a bubbly tune.
We found every pair… I gave a slow, happy bow.
I bobbed my head to the beat… we found every pair.
We found every pair… now I tap out a quick, clever tune.
We found every pair… I stretched up tall and proud.
I fluffed up, all cozy… we found every pair.
We found every pair… now I sing a tune like the sea.

bond_up_2.text: My feathers are humming. I think they like you.

bond_up_3.text: I can see my own colors now. Ooh… pretty.
bond_up_3.short: I can see my own colors now.

bond_up_4.text: This is my real shape. Thank you for listening.

bond_up_5.text: So many notes… we made all of them together.

found_lullaby.text: …Hello. I made up a new lullaby. Want to hear?
found_lullaby.short: I made up a new lullaby.

found_stars.text: Hello. I counted eleven stars. Twelve now.

found_book.text: …Hi. I was reading about clouds. Shall I tell you?

found_sunrise.text: Good morning… the sky just turned peach.

found_nap.text: Hello. I had a cozy nap in the hollow.

found_lantern.text: Hello. The fireflies and I were sharing the lantern.

routine_sunset.text: The sky is going purple… my favorite part.

found_branch_door.text: …The hollow door is open now. It's softly glowing inside.
found_branch_door.short: The hollow door is open now.

found_branch_tip.text: …I was tidying a feather. Smooth now.

found_library_first.text: …I found a room full of stories. Shall we listen a while?

found_library_nook.text: …I was reading. This page has a moon in it.

found_library_sill.text: The window has a little piece of sky in it.

found_hilltop_first.text: …Up here the sky is so big. I like that.
found_hilltop_first.short: Up here the sky is so big.

found_hilltop_branch.text: Hello… I was counting stars. I lost count.

found_hilltop_blanket.text: That cloud looks like a teacup. Or a sleepy sheep… maybe both.

wild_glance.text: …Something smelled of pine tonight. From far away.
wild_glance.gesture: head turns slowly toward the far trees

wild_glance.text: Something called, way past the far trees… it sounded like a hello.
That little star, low in the sky… I wonder what it's for.
wild_glance.gesture: slow blink at its star, low over the far trees

wild_glance.text: My feathers keep turning toward that little star… I don't mind.
The wild hums so softly… you have to be very still to hear it.
I'm learning so much here… my wings feel tingly.

bondup_after_3.text: A little song just floated by, far past the branches. I wonder…
bondup_after_3.gesture: looks at the faint home star

bondup_after_4.text: My song feels bigger… it hums with all I learned here.

bondup_after_5.text: …My song is so big now. Hum, hum.
bondup_after_5.gesture: looks at the bright home star, then back at you
bondup_after_5.short: My song is so big now.

restless.text: My wings stretched toward my star all by themselves.
I dreamed of the wild… and woke up here. Both nice.
The far trees are humming a little louder lately… a happy hum.

almost_hello.text: Hello. Another little star came out, right near mine.
almost_hello.gesture: perched on the branch; a new star in the trail

almost_hello.text: …There you are. Shall we pick something from our list?
almost_hello.short: Shall we pick from our list?

almost_hello.text: Well… hello. I was practicing a gentle flying-day hum.

list_nudge.text: Any one you like today… or none. Just being here counts.

list_play_done.text: {var:listGame}… that's a new note for my song.

list_food_done.text: I'll keep the taste of that one. Thank you.

list_place_done.text: Our nest is woven… I'll remember every twig.

list_trail_done.text: Moonlight Glide… I'll hum about it for a long while.

list_memory_done.text: That story is tucked in my feathers now… safe and warm.

list_cozy_done.text: …That was a lovely quiet sit. One for the list.
list_cozy_done.short: That was a lovely quiet sit.

list_complete.text: Every little thing on our list… we did them all.

stay_more.text: Not yet… then I'll stay a few more nights. We'll watch the sky.
…A few more days, then. I like that. Then home to my wild life.

last_day.text: …Our next day together will be flying day. Let's make today a gentle one.

time_to_go.text: …Today's flying day. My wings can feel it. Will you sit with me on the branch?
time_to_go.gesture: hops to the branch tip, looks back, waits

one_more_game.text: One more game… and then our branch. That sounds just right.

after_one_more.text: A lovely game. Flying day, whenever you're ready.

hug_more.text: One more hug is always allowed.
That one was extra soft. I'll keep it.

walk_start.text: …Let's hop out along our branch. Slowly. I'd like this to last a while.

walk_memory.text: Remember? {memory}. I'm keeping that one close.
walk_memory.gesture: a star lights up in the sky

walk_memory.text: Oh… {memory}. I still smile about it.
walk_memory.gesture: a star lights up in the sky

walk_list.text: We shared our whole list… every little thing.
We shared so much of our list… the rest I'll hum to myself.
walk_list.short: The rest I'll hum to myself.

edge_arrive.text: The tip of our branch. And there, low in the sky… my star.
edge_arrive.gesture: hops to the branch tip, looks up at its star

edge_explain.text: Remember… I came to learn about here. Now I'll take it home, gently.
edge_explain.short: I came to learn about here.

edge_explain.text: It's all in my song… every sound, every story. And you.

gift_ask.text: Before I go… may I carry something of yours? Something to remember you by.

gift_got.text: The {gift}… I'll keep it right beside me in the hollow. Thank you.

keepsake_give.text: And this is for you… a song feather. A little of my song is in it.
keepsake_give.gesture: a glowing feather drifts down to your side

keepsake_give.text: When it hums… a postcard has arrived.

thanks.text: Thank you, {child}… for listening, and for letting me listen to you.
You helped our song grow… slowly and warmly. Thank you.

next_postcards.text: Here's what happens next… I'll turn into little notes and float to my star.
My wild hollow is under that star… where the bird songs live.
And I'll write to you… the first postcard comes after one sleep.

farewell.text: My heart feels big and happy… and a little heavy. Both.

resume_edge.text: …Here we are, still on our branch at twilight. Shall we go on?

path_tap_early.text: Today? Oh… then we'll share our list out on the branch.

look_back.gesture: wings up at the branch tip, looks back once, slow blink

look_back.text: When you hear a bird sing… that's a little hello from me.

thanks_wave.text: Hello and goodbye… both at once.

thanks_words.text: Thank you too. I'll keep that.

write_a_lot.text: Often at first… then now and then. Feathers write slowly.

run_start.text: Hold to rise… let go to float. I like that.
Well… the sky is so big.
run_start.short: Well... the sky is so big.

run_start.text: Trees and clouds… we'll drift past them.

run_treasure.text: A little star… it lifts my wings.
A star. I can float longer now.

run_gold.text: A moon piece… if I bump, it catches me.
A bit of moon. It glows.
run_gold.short: A bit of moon. It glows.

run_stretch.text: Another hill… the stars came too.

run_best.text: Our farthest yet. I like that.

run_done.text: What a gentle flight. Let's rest a while.
Rest now… my wings are humming.

I'm thinking about something warm to nibble.
Something smells nice… I'm pretending not to notice. It isn't working.
My tummy gave a tiny rumble… it said please, though.
need_hungry.short: My tummy gave a tiny rumble…

…My home sky hums softly. Hugs sound a bit like that.
…I was thinking of my star nest. It's warm here with you, too.
…my feathers are extra soft today. I fluffed them up just for a hug.

need_playful.text: …my wings feel all fluttery. Shall we play a game?
Let's listen for the tiniest sound in the world… Shh… was that you?
Let's count the clouds… until we lose count.

A soft nap would be lovely right now.
That big yawn means I'm sleepy… in bird talk.
…the yawns are visiting me. Three came… and one brought a friend.
…my hollow looks so cozy right now.
Hoo-hoo… I feel so sleepy now.

need_content.text: …everything feels good today. Even the leaves look happy.
I feel calm and happy, right here with you.
…my tummy is cozy, and my feathers are tidy. My heart feels warm.
…I could stay on this branch a long, happy while.
I hummed a little tune… I think the crickets joined in.
Hoo-hoo… I feel so happy now.

after_hug.text: …there. I feel snug again. Thank you.
We're wing to wing… just right.
That hug warmed every one of my feathers.

after_play.text: …that was a lovely game. My wings are smiling.

wake_up.text: Mm. I dreamed of a quiet pond. Hello again.
wake_up.short: I dreamed of a quiet pond.

look_tap.text: Hoo-hoo… my feathers are all neat now.

weather_snow.text: …snow is falling very quietly here.
Cold. Sparkly.
Snow… soft and white.
A snowflake… on my beak.
Fluffed up… warm and round.
So quiet… snow is falling.
Little footprints… in the snow.
Each snowflake here falls with a tiny hush… shh.
I puffed up my feathers… it's like wearing a coat.
The branch is wearing a white snow scarf today.
I'm catching snowflakes… with my wing.
Snow makes the whole hilltop glow softly… so pretty.
Birds fluff our feathers in snow… trapped air keeps us toasty.
Most snowflakes have six points… and no two look the same.
weather_snow.short: And no two look the same.

weather_snow.text: Snow soaks up sound like a sponge… that's why it's so hushed.
Some birds tuck one foot up in the cold… to keep it warm.
Fresh snow shows every track… I see little hops over there.
Hoo-hoo… I'm as fluffy as the snow.
weather_snow.short: I'm as fluffy as the snow.

weather_snow.text: Chirp-trill… I fluff into a round little snowball.
Quack-quack… I waddle happily through the snow.
Coo-coo… I'm as white as the snow.
weather_snow.short: I'm as white as the snow.

weather_snow.text: Coo-roo… I fluff up on my stone ledge.
Caw-click… my dark feathers pop against the snow.
Kree-kree… snowy peaks look like mountains of sugar.
Bawk-cluck… snow is cold on my toes… I'll stay in the straw.
weather_snow.short: Snow is cold on my toes...

weather_snow.text: Kree-kee… snow on the beach looks like sugar sand.
Snow here… so soft… snowing there too?
Snowflakes are drifting past my nest… is it snowy where you are?
weather_snow.short: Is it snowy where you are?

weather_snow.text: My branch wears a little snow blanket today… what's the weather doing where you are?

food_meat_nibbles.text: Savory. A small nibble, then another small nibble.

food_fish_sticks.text: Fish sticks… crunchy outside, soft inside… yum.

food_salmon_bites.text: …salmon. Pink and warm. My favorite color of dinner.

food_tuna_sandwich.text: …a tuna sandwich. I'll take very small, careful bites.

food_chicken_soup.text: …warm soup. I'm holding the warm with both wings.

food_mac_and_cheese.text: Mac and cheese. Soft little noodle moons.

food_pizza.text: …pizza. The cheese made a long, long bridge.

food_mashed_potatoes.text: Mashed potatoes… like a soft little cloud.

food_rice_bowl.text: …rice. Hundreds of tiny pillows. I counted three.

food_scrambled_eggs.text: …fluffy eggs. Soft as my belly feathers.

food_oatmeal_honey.text: Oatmeal with a honey swirl… a very cozy breakfast.

food_chamomile.text: …chamomile. It smells like a quiet garden.

food_blueberries.text: …blueberries. Small and round, like little night skies.

food_pear_slices.text: …pear. Soft and a little drippy. Mm.

food_apple_slices.text: …apple. A crisp little crunch. Pardon me.

food_banana.text: …banana. Soft and sweet. No crunching needed.

food_grilled_cheese.text: …grilled cheese. Warm, and a little stretchy.

food_dumplings.text: …dumplings. Little pockets with a surprise inside.

food_rice_ball.text: …a rice ball. Round, like the moon on a good night.

food_spaghetti.text: …one very long noodle. I'm being patient with it.

food_meatballs.text: …meatballs. Round and warm. I'll start with one.

food_sweet_potato.text: …sweet potato. Orange, like the sky at dusk.

food_peas.text: …peas. Each one is a tiny green pearl.

food_yogurt.text: …yogurt. A little stays on my beak. That's fine.
food_yogurt.short: A little stays on my beak.

food_honey_cake.text: …a honey cake. Sweet, and very soft.

food_oat_cookie.text: …a cookie. I'll make it last a long time.

food_birthday_cake.text: …cake. A little party, just for a moment.

food_ice_pop.text: Very cold. My beak is shivering. You enjoy it.

food_hot_sauce.text: …Oh. Spicy. My ear tufts went straight up. Not for me.

food_lemon.text: …sour. My eyes went small. This one is yours.

food_granola_bar.text: …crumbs in my feathers. A softer snack?

food_toffee.text: …very sticky. My beak is stuck… no, it's free. Phew.

food_sparkling_water.text: …fizzy. It tickles my beak. Plain water?

tilts its head back, happy eyes

name_call.text: There you are. Come and see.
Good morning… The sky is peach.

name_changed.text: {child}. A new name… it sounds lovely.

invite_hum.text: …You saw an owl. I'm the little song it hums.
A {var:origin_animal} sang, and here I am. Hello…

invite_yes.text: Yes. I'd love to come along.
